queries.title: LEIs, company names, ISINs or BICs
queries.description: Required unless datasetId is set. One per line; the type is auto-detected. Examples: "HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394" (LEI), "Siemens AG | DE" (name with optional country), "US0378331005" (ISIN), "DEUTDEFFXXX" (BIC). Force a type with a prefix: "name: ...", "lei: ...", "isin: ...", "bic: ...".

includeParents.title: Include parent companies
includeParents.description: Add the direct and ultimate accounting parent (LEI, name, country) when reported to GLEIF. Costs 1-2 extra API calls per record, so large runs take longer. Default true.

maxMatchesPerName.title: Matches per name
maxMatchesPerName.description: For company-name searches, return up to this many best matches (1-10, default 1). Each returned record is charged.

minNameScore.title: Minimum name score
minNameScore.description: Only return name matches scoring at least this (0-100, default 80). Lower it for loose matching; misses are free not_found rows.

onlyActive.title: Only active entities
onlyActive.description: Skip entities whose status is not ACTIVE (e.g. merged or dissolved). Default false.

defaultCountry.title: Default country for names
defaultCountry.description: Optional ISO 2-letter code (e.g. "DE") applied to name searches without a "| XX" hint.

maxQueries.title: Max queries
maxQueries.description: Run at most this many unique queries (default 2000). Aliases: maxItems, limit, maxResults.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Read LEIs or company names from another run's dataset. In an integration the triggering run's dataset is used automatically.

queryField.title: Query field in that dataset
queryField.description: Field holding the LEI or company name (dot paths work). Leave empty to auto-detect: lei, LEI, isin, bic, companyName, name, company, legalName.

countryField.title: Country field in that dataset
countryField.description: Optional field with a 2-letter country code used as the name-search hint.

datasetMaxItems.title: Max values from the dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many values from the dataset (default 1000).

includeLegalFormName.title: Resolve legal form names
includeLegalFormName.description: Turn ELF codes like "H1UM" into names like "For-Profit Corporation General Stock" (cached; one call per distinct code). Default true.
